experiment_question: What paid Codex coordinator token and cash cost is required to plan and delegate a full TSA23 instance-bootstrap phase to a local/free supervisor-agent workflow?

checkpoint_spans.description: Codex coordinator planning, issue recovery, roadmap setup, budget declaration, and delegated-supervisor ticket creation.
Codex review of delegated supervisor result, PR state, and merge-readiness decision after the local/free supervisor stops.

stop_condition.description: Stop after one delegated phase attempt and require maintainer/Codex review before retry, scope expansion, or PR merge.

maintainer_checkpoint.trigger: before P108 PR merge, any second delegated-supervisor attempt, or any expansion beyond bootstrap planning/scaffold
maintainer_checkpoint.decision_surface: ignored delegated result report plus tracked public-safe roadmap/changelog/planning updates
